after.name: Disintegrate
after.acceptedSharedRuleScope: Only Disintegrate and the original shared requirements applicable to it, including its original LM130-LIFE dust clause as completed by LM130-DISINTEGRATE-R02-SCOPE, are newly accepted. Earlier Core death/replacement priority and independent temporal-provider contracts retain their actual scope; no global damage/temporal rule is introduced. Four previously applied LifeMatter procedure objects/index selections remain unchanged. All explicit content/fixture/runtime/human/balance/cosmology/release holds remain.
